Expected I/O worked out from OpenRGB's C++ (commit d4798c120659ec5ba2e664a9e87bedff8d36f880, Controllers/RoccatController/RoccatVulcanKeyboardController and RoccatControllerDetect.cpp) by a separate reference model (openrgb-work/batch2/roccat/gen.py in the porting session's scratch space, not in the repository) that mirrors InitDeviceInfo, EnableDirect, WaitUntilReady, SendColors, ClearResponses and AwaitResponse buffer by buffer; plugin.js was never run to make them. One case per OpenRGB registration for this vendor id (plus extra layout cases). info_reply is the GET_FEATURE answer the mock device gives to the info request (byte 2 firmware version, byte 6 layout), ready_reply the answer to report 0x04. Deliberate HueDeck deviations modelled here (see docs/hardware/roccat-vulcan.md): OpenRGB's SendMode (the 0x0D / 0x11 mode report the keyboard stores) is never sent, so Initialize is info read, EnableDirect(on), ready wait; Shutdown is EnableDirect(off) and a ready wait (the keyboard's own lighting); a layout OpenRGB has no table for falls back to US, else the table's only layout; LEDs OpenRGB places in no matrix cell are sent black. ops: set_endpoint = switch to the control (ctrl) or LED (led) collection; get_report = GET_FEATURE of report id at length; send_report = SET_FEATURE; write = output report (65 bytes, report id 0x00 first); read = input report read on the LED collection (timeout ms). Colours: colours_a / colours_b per LED in LED order.
